title: A Real-Time Fleet Management System for Islamabad's Metro Bus Service
subtitle: Live tracking, route control, and station management in one platform
blurb: Built a real-time bus fleet management system for Inlights, a company working with the Capital Development Authority (CDA) Islamabad, covering route and stop creation, live bus tracking and speed monitoring, bus-to-route assignment, and per-stop digital screen and announcement control.
result: Gave Inlights a single system to manage routes, stops, and live fleet monitoring for Islamabad's metro bus service

meta.solutions: Web Development, Real-Time Fleet Tracking, Backend Systems

whoFor: Inlights, a company actively working with the Capital Development Authority (CDA) of Islamabad on the city's metro bus service.
challengeIntro: Inlights needed a centralized way to manage the metro bus network's routes and stops, monitor the live status of buses across the fleet, and control the information shown to passengers at each stop.
challengePoints: No digital system for creating and managing bus routes and stops
No way to assign buses to specific routes from a central system
No live visibility into bus location or speed across the fleet
No way to manage or update digital screen content and announcements at individual stops
builtIntro: A backend system built with Django and MongoDB, giving administrators full control over the fleet, routes, and station-level communication.
builtPoints: Announcement and warning broadcasting to stops
builtOutro: Administrators can manage the entire network from route planning down to what's displayed on a screen at an individual stop, with live visibility into where every bus is and how fast it's moving.
